query.sql:
SELECT date_trunc('minute', ts) AS bucket, count(*) AS events
FROM holotable_self
GROUP BY bucket
ORDER BY bucket

panels.title: holotable_self rate
panels.description: Rows written to holotable_self per minute — the traffic this table sees.

query.sql:
SELECT date_trunc('minute', ts) AS bucket, outcome, count(*) AS events
FROM holotable_self
GROUP BY bucket, outcome
ORDER BY bucket DESC, events DESC

panels.title: holotable_self by outcome
panels.description: Rows per minute broken down by outcome. The catalog does not say which value means failure, so the breakdown is shown whole rather than guessed at — narrow it in the SQL once you know.
